name: JavaScriptKit
description: Swift framework to interact with JavaScript through WebAssembly.

issues.title: Support exporting structs as a reference
Avoid copying and re-encoding for String every time
BridgeJS: SwiftSyntax's BasicFormat usage in code generators takes too much time
[SwiftBuild] Preserve duplicate archive members when SwiftBuild expands static archives for linking

latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* BridgeJS: Check thrown errors before lifting return values by @krodak in https://github.com/swiftwasm/JavaScriptKit/pull/824
* BridgeJS: Diagnose async and throwing @JS struct initializers by @krodak in https://github.com/swiftwasm/JavaScriptKit/pull/825
* BridgeJS: Fix JSValue reference ownership across the bridge by @krodak in https://github.com/swiftwasm/JavaScriptKit/pull/826
* PackageToJS: Import only the UWASI features Swift needs by @krodak in https://github.com/swiftwasm/JavaScriptKit/pull/827


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/swiftwasm/JavaScriptKit/compare/0.62.0...0.63.0
